game:characterdesc-ghost-angryspirit: why breath hate? why is hate in every action? why is resent in every word you say? why must you hate the very thing you came from spirit of wrath?
game:characterdesc-ghost-glottony: can you really be full with the hole within your form? can a spirit without flesh really be feed? why fuel a leaking soul? though you may try to feed that void i can only see that you are suffering spirit of gluttony... i just hope you see it.
game:characterdesc-ghost-noble: dead yet still holds onto a golden crown of lies.. why are you still here in the living? to take more from the living for your tomb? i shall watch you spirit of greed
game:characterdesc-ghost-wanderingspirit: oh wondering spirit, why must you follow the wind? why do you linger within the world embrace? to you who is in search for someone that has long faded, to wander for so long...i pity you spirit of lust
game:characterdesc-ghost-ancient: its been a long time spirit... why must you still linger? is it resent? a longing? is it pride? i suppose you dont remember anyways spirit of pride....
game:characterdesc-ghost-poltergeist: oh spirit, why must you inflict your will onto the world? why breath resent for the living when you are already dead?... i loath you spirit of envy for taking my eyes
game:characterdesc-ghost-underground: why come out old spirit?, the one who slept within the abbyss of the earths maw... why have the will to impose your will onto the world one again?...i grow worry spirit of slought
